Synopsis:
    World Athletics is embracing the creator economy, with athletes increasingly monetizing social media, brand deals, and side ventures to supplement income in a sport with limited guaranteed salaries. The 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship in Budapest featured a dedicated red-carpet media day designed to give athletes controlled content creation space. The trend raises governance questions — highlighted by the U.S. Open influencer incident — but the sport is broadly adapting through designated creator zones and structured opportunities.
